title: Christmas Day: Tsutenkaku and Shinsekai · Yaekatsu kushikatsu snack · Chitose okonomiyaki lunch · Tsuruhashi Korea Town · Osaka Castle · Umeda Sky at sunset · Fukushima robata · Ura-Namba crawl · Circus · Round1 to the first train

stops.name: Kujō House: send suitcases to Garfield House (Yamato TA-Q-BIN)
stops.plan: Send the big suitcases to Garfield House (Shinjuku) for Sat 26 evening delivery (front desk or nearest konbini; confirm the host can receive them). Keep tax-free goods and an overnight bag with you.
stops.price: Yamato rate per suitcase, by size
stops.transport: Walk to Nishikujō (or Hanshin one stop), JR Osaka Loop line Nishikujō → Shin-Imamiya, walk to Tsutenkaku, about 40 min door to door

stops.name: Tsutenkaku & Shinsekai
stops.plan: Up Tsutenkaku for the morning view and the Billiken, then a quick loop of Shinsekai's retro streets.
stops.price: Tower deck ticket (check price at the gate)
stops.transport: Walk to Jan Jan Yokocho, 4 min

stops.name: Yaekatsu
stops.plan: In at the 10:30 opening, before the queue: a quick round of skewers each (takeaway works for 5+ skewers). Keep it light, okonomiyaki is next. No double-dipping; cash.
stops.price: about ¥1,000 pp for a few skewers
stops.transport: Walk to Chitose, about 9 min; be in line before 11:30

stops.name: Okonomiyaki Chitose (Taishi)
stops.plan: Okonomiyaki lunch to share; 8 may be seated in two goes and it can sell out. Check the day's hours on Google Maps before going (listed Fri lunch from 11:30).
stops.transport: Walk to Shin-Imamiya, JR Osaka Loop line → Momodani, walk into Korea Town, about 45 min door to door

stops.name: Osaka Ikuno Korea Town (Tsuruhashi)
stops.plan: Graze hotteok, tteokbokki and kimchi along the street; stalls close by early evening.
stops.transport: Walk to Momodani/Tsuruhashi, JR Osaka Loop line → Morinomiya, walk to the Main Tower, about 55 min door to door

stops.name: Osaka Castle Main Tower
stops.plan: Museum floors and the top-deck view; last entry 17:30.
stops.transport: Walk to Morinomiya, Osaka Metro Chuo line → Hommachi, Midosuji line → Umeda, walk to the Sky Building, about 50 min door to door

stops.name: Umeda Sky Building – Kuchu Teien + Christmas 2026
stops.plan: Floating Garden deck at sunset, then the German-style Christmas market below on its last day (ends today). Expect a lift queue.

stops.name: Robatayaki Homuraya
stops.plan: BOOK NOW: Christmas Day table for 8 at 18:15 via the website; cheap robata grill plates and drinks before the big night.
stops.transport: JR Osaka Loop line Fukushima → Osaka, Osaka Metro Midosuji line Umeda → Namba, walk to Sennichimae, about 35 min

stops.name: Ura-Namba drinking district
stops.plan: Standing-bar crawl in two groups of 4, 1–2 drinks per stop; Christmas plus year-end parties make it packed, so keep moving.
stops.transport: Walk to Namba, Osaka Metro Midosuji line Namba → Shinsaibashi, walk into Ame-mura, about 20 min

stops.name: Circus Osaka (club)
stops.plan: Christmas-night party in Ame-mura (open Thu–Sat). Check the event schedule and buy advance tickets; photo ID required, 20+ only.

stops.name: Round1 Stadium Sennichimae
stops.plan: Two karaoke rooms of 4 (or one big room) to ride out the night until the first train; show the Round1 app for member prices.
stops.price: Karaoke from ¥440 one-order minimum pp, plus room charge
stops.transport: Walk to Osaka-Namba, first Hanshin Namba line train to Kujō (2 stops), walk home; or taxi, 2 cars

stops.name: Kujō House
stops.plan: Home for a few hours' sleep; check-out is 10:00 on the 26th.
